node.title: Re^3: I match a pattern in regex, yet I don't get the group I wanted to extract for some reason
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Glad to hear it! I noticed that in your code you have my $tagl = $resp->decoded_content;, so I assume you're using an HTTP client to get the HTML. Note that [mod://Mojolicious] includes [mod://Mojo::UserAgent], which has direct integration with [mod://Mojo::DOM] - I showed an example [id://11117612|here].
